location.description: Required. The GCP location for the backup vault should be on approved region.
location.rationale: Location determines physical hosting region and data residency.

name.description: Required. The name of management server (management console)
name.rationale: Name has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

type.description: Required. The type of management server (management console).
type.rationale: Type has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

networks.description: Required. The correct VPC networks to which the resource is attached.
networks.rationale: Restricting operations to approved networks reduces exposure and prevents unintended access

network.rationale: The selected VPC network defines the security boundary and connectivity scope for the resource.

peering_mode.description: Required. Type of Network peeringMode Default value is `PRIVATE_SERVICE_ACCESS`.
peering_mode.rationale: Peering mode determines how the network connects to other services and affects security posture.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: even without manual ID configuration ID will be automatically generated.
